data.one_liner: Turns input points into a polygon of outline points for drawing pressure-sensitive freehand lines.
data.what_it_does: Generates points for a smooth polygon outline based on an array of input points and customizable options like size, thinning, and smoothing. It supports pressure sensitivity either via input point data or simulated based on distance.
use_when: You need to build a drawing or signature-capture app in Flutter.
You want pressure-sensitive freehand strokes rendered via CustomPainter.
avoid_when: You are looking for a fully-featured pre-built canvas widget with built-in undo/redo and storage.
You are using Dart without Flutter (versions 1.x are required for non-Flutter).
strengths: Port of a robust and popular JavaScript freehand stroke library.
Highly customizable options for stroke size, thinning, smoothing, streamline, and tapering.
Supports both real pressure data and simulated pressure.
weaknesses: Does not include rendering widgets out of the box (requires CustomPainter implementation).
No built-in management for undo/redo stacks or drawing state.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the package dependency via pubspec.yaml or pub add.
